excerpt.zh: 长程扫描仪获取了[This.System.GetName]恒星系中的数据，对其的解析几乎说明它是一个巨大热源。这非常值得研究。
excerpt.en: Long range scanners have picked up readings in the [This.System.GetName] system that could best be described as giant heat blobs. It's worth investigating.
